name: Incline Chest-Supported Curl (Preacher-Style)
description: Set an incline bench to about 45 degrees and lean into it chest-first (chest-supported). Rest the armpit and the back of the upper arm flat against the pad, holding a dumbbell with an underhand grip so the arm hangs down the face of the pad. Curl the weight up by flexing at the elbow, keeping the upper arm flat on the pad the entire rep, then lower to a full stretch. The pad braces the arm and eliminates swing — a preacher-curl substitute used when the preacher bench is taken. The left bicep is the weaker side; lead with it.
